==Welcome==
Greetings and welcome to my talk page. As an [[Aes Sedai (Age of Legends)|Aes Sedai]] from [[Age of Legends|an earlier age]] I often find this modern wiki world more satisfying when editors interact frequently. So please feel absolutely free to write on my talk page. I'm open to all feedback and discussion about pages, edits, or anything else you think is worth talking about. We're all here to enrich this wiki and promote a highly interactive environment!

Until then I shall return to my work. The [[Ogier]] of this age have been kind enough to allow me to labor on this wiki from a [[Stedding]] to shield me from [[Saidin]]. Just don't ask how they manage to get me on the internet....

[[User:Servant of All|Servant of All]]

== Categories ==

Hello. I saw that you added all of those items to the "Items of Power" category. I don't know if you knew this, but the ''angreal'', ''sa'angreal'', and ''ter'angreal'' categories are all subcategorized under the Items of Power category. So adding that to all of those seems redundant. Please let me know what you think. Thanks! ---- {{User:Mainphramephreak/Sig/Subst}} 23:19, February 24, 2014 (UTC)

Hello again. A lot of the categories for characters are controlled by the {{tl|Character}} template. Several different parameters can be set by that template and a good number of them add the page to categories. As for Graendal, the reason she is listed as both dead and alive is because Graendal is dead, but Hessalam is still alive. Right now, all of the Forsaken that have been reincarnated have two different character templates on them. Another example would be [[Balthamel]] who has both the male and female categories.

I also wanted to go back to Items of Power category for a minute. I know what you said about them all being items of Power, and should be identified as such. However, when you look at the [[:Category:Items of Power|Items of Power category]], you see all of it and then you go into any of the [[:Category:Angreal|Angreal]], [[:Category:Sa'angreal|Sa'angreal]], and [[:Category:Ter'angreal|Ter'angreal]] categories. There, you see many of the same things. To me, it seems redundant to have a page in one category as well as in one of its sub-categories. Let me know what you think. Also, let me know if you have any other questions. Thanks! ---- {{User:Mainphramephreak/Sig/Subst}} 05:01, March 12, 2014 (UTC)

==Nynaeve Picture Example==
Kay - the picture you supplied as an example of an "awful" picture is in fact an official image that comes from the [[The World of Robert Jordan's The Wheel of Time]] and was drawn by Todd Cameron Hamilton. The fact that you do not know this is disappointing and indicates that you are either not paying attention to canon source material or you are ignorant that these things even exist. I'm not a fan of the images from that book either, but it is OFFICIAL which gives it all the weight it needs to be on the page.
